title: Out Now — artist screen
slide_intent: Make a release recognizable at a glance because environmental displays compete with surrounding light and activity.
strategic_value: Spotify can place the artist first while a small corner logo identifies the platform.
demonstration: A landscape screen shows a yellow-orange portrait in a cowboy hat, a purple field and large Out Now lettering inside a dark event space.
practical_value: Assess portrait scale and message length for a display viewed at distance.

content_islands.name: Release artwork
content_islands.spec: A large face and hat occupy the screen; Out Now overlaps its lower portion.

content_islands.name: Platform signature
content_islands.spec: A small Spotify mark occupies the upper-right corner.

content_islands.name: Venue
content_islands.spec: The surrounding dark room establishes the screen as an environmental application.

reference_purposes.Expression: A landscape screen shows a yellow-orange portrait in a cowboy hat, a purple field and large Out Now lettering inside a dark event space.
reference_purposes.Application: The source shows this identity in the pictured campaign or event setting.
